DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you passionate about automation? Do you want to join a team of talented individuals focusing on building and maintaining CI/CD, IaaC and Container Orchestration.
• Responsible for the overall health, performance, and capacity of gaming platform services
• Monitor and manage the core gaming platform to ensure SLAs are met
• Build and manage systems, infrastructure and applications through automation
• Develop strategy, processes, and shape our existing infrastructure and support procedures

You'd be really excited to:

You will serve as a primary point responsible for the overall health, performance, and capacity of gaming platform services. This can involve troubleshooting issues across the entire stack: hardware, software, application and network, and other days, identify and drive opportunities to improve automation for the company.
• Gain deep application-level knowledge of the systems as well as contributing to their overall design and drive standardization efforts across... multiple disciplines and services
• Manage timely resolution of all critical and/or complex problems meeting SLA requirements
• Ability to effectively communicate with all levels of management and all stakeholders
• Develop, configure and optimize service and application monitoring and telemetry
• Assist in the rollouts and deployment of new product features and installations
• Configuring tools to improve our ability to rapidly deploy and effectively monitor applications and services in a large-scale environment
• Work closely with development teams to ensure that platforms are designed with "operability" in mind.

You're really awesome at:
• Proficient in scripting languages such as Bash, Python, or PowerShell for automation and infrastructure management tasks.
• Experience with Kubernetes and Docker
• Experience with Kubernetes tooling, such as helm and helmfiles
• Experience running a multi-node/ multi-tier web application architectures
• Experience with Event Driven Architecture and message streaming such as Kafka
• Experience in Observability [monitoring, logging, tracing]
• Experience with Continuous Deployment and Integration tools such as GitHub Actions
• Experience supporting Linux and Windows systems
• Familiarity or willingness for working with development languages & frameworks, particularly GoLang and/or C# .NET
• Experience with cloud computing platforms and services such as Amazon

Benefits
• Hybrid Working Model
• International Health Insurance
• GiG Wellbeing Benefit (EUR 350)
• Career and Development Opportunities
• Coaching and Mentoring
• Birthday Leave
• Free Lunches
• Free Parking

A propos de Talan****Why Talan? **For almost 20 years, Talan Group has been advising companies and administrations, supporting them and implementing their transformation projects in Europe, America, Africa and Asia. Our main goal is to support organizations in their journey to the future. In Talan Spain we make it real through digital transformation. We put people at the center, and we rely on collective intelligence, diversity, pragmatism and agility. We believe in environments based on trust, excellence, collaboration, flexibility and respect. In addition, we lean on cultural, business, Agile and technological transformation through Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Blockchain and RPAs. At Talan we are looking for people like you:

innovative, talented and eager to improve every day in our environment. **In our sunny Málaga IT Center of Excellence in Spain** we want to participate in both local and international projects of the Talan group. It's a great opportunity **to rellocate... to Spain** and join a team of IT experts and help us bring value to our clients. You need **support to rellocate**? DevOps Engineer

Madrid I Hybrid

APPLY

Our client is a global leader in the chemical industry and is characterized by the development of innovative solutions in various sectors. Join their rapidly growing and international Digital Hub in Madrid to become part of their digitalization journey.

Your Responsibilities:

• Implementing GitOps for cloud native infrastructure and various applications

Your... Profile:

• At least 3 years of professional experience in DevOps Engineering
• Experience working in agile environments
• Innovative team player who is willing to develop further with a passion for challenges
• High level of English

Your Benefits:
• A secure work environment because your health, safety and wellbeing is always prioritized
• Generous compensation package and favorable working conditions
• Flexible working hours and remote friendly (2 days per week office policy)
• Multinational, diverse team where respect, support and openness is highly valued
• Broad learning and development opportunities
• 30 days of vacation per year: 23 days per agreement + 5 days for possible overtime compensation + 2 days cultural festivities
• Relocation assistance to Madrid provided

If you are interested in this challenging position we are looking forward to receiving your comprehensive application for ref.no. 102.204 preferably through our ISG career portal or via email.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you passionate about enabling people and organisations to make informed decisions in a contextual and efficient way?

The Company

Welcome to the world of contextual decision intelligence, a revolutionary approach to data analysis. Our client, founded in 2016, is a global software leader dedicated to making data more meaningful. They provide a single networked view of internal and external data, driving analytical and AI models that address critical aspects such as compliance, fraud prevention, anti-money laundering, and more. Their partners include global tier 1 insurers, banks, government agencies, telecomms, and technology giants. Join their journey to deliver contextual decision intelligence!

Your Role:

We are in search of mid, senior, and lead level DevOps engineers to meet the surging demands for their cloud solutions, the cornerstone of our company’s rapid expansion. This role presents an exceptional opportunity to engage with cutting-edge cloud technologies and... contribute to industry-leading cloud-based offerings of our platform.

What You’ll Do:

As a member of the DevOps teams within the R&D department, you’ll be immersed in their Cloud platform and related solutions. Their platform is a well-crafted landscape of low-maintenance, on-demand, and highly secure environments. These environments support an array of use cases, including fraud detection, news intelligence, machine learning, and natural language processing, to name a few. In addition, they facilitate various internal functions such as research and development (R&D) and software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes.

Your responsibilities will encompass enhancing the availability and resilience of our platform, improving its usability and security, staying at the forefront of technical innovation, and reducing operational burden. You’ll also collaborate closely with our software engineering teams, employing DevOps techniques to support software release activities and create unique cloud-based product offerings for our customers to use within their own DevOps processes.

Key Achievements:
• A team that has grown to 500+ talented professionals.
• Valuation exceeding $900 million.
• Proud recipient of the Google Cloud 2020 Industry Solutions Partner of the Year award.

Our Technology Stack:
• A robust focus on Docker, Kubernetes, and Istio.
• DevOps tooling and automation leveraging Bash, Python, Groovy, Jenkins, and Golang.
• Provisioning software and frameworks like Elasticsearch, Spark, Hadoop, and PostgreSQL.
• Infrastructure Management, including Configuration as Code (CasC) and Infrastructure as Code (IaSC) using Ansible, Terraform, and Packer.
• Log and metric aggregation powered by Fluentd, Prometheus, Grafana, and Alertmanager.
• Utilization of public cloud resources, primarily GCP, with additional capabilities on AWS and Azure.

What We Expect:

To thrive in this role, you should:
• Take pride in designing and delivering high-quality solutions to complex problems.
• Embrace a holistic approach to problem-solving, ensuring solutions align seamlessly within the broader system.
• Possess in-depth expertise in several components of our tech stack as mentioned above.
• Exhibit experience in programming, scripting, and automation.
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of information security principles.
• Have experience in infrastructure management and general Linux administration.
• Fluent in both English and Spanish.

Additional Experience That Counts:

Beneficial experience includes:
• Managing microservice-based architectures (scaling, upgrading, traffic management, deployment strategies).
• Mentoring junior engineers.
• Involvement in software build and release engineering.

Job Owner:j.sparshott

Tagged as: AWS , Azure , Jenkins , Kubernetes , Scala , SQL
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero Superior Devops AWS
jobs_results.description:
Desde Ingefor International, buscamos un perfil "Ingenior Superior Devops con experiencia en AWS", con al menos 6 años de experiencia, para trabajar e incorporar a uno de nuestros principales proyectos y cliente.

Funciones:

-Servir como experto interno y guiar la configuración de la cuenta de AWS y las configuraciones de S3.

-Supervisar las operaciones diarias para entornos de computación en la nube personalizados para ensayos basados en secuenciación.

-Planificar y ejecutar mecanismos de respaldo y recuperación ante desastres para datos en la nube asociados con canalizaciones de análisis UDx.

-Liderar la resolución de problemas y el análisis de la causa raíz de los problemas de implementación asociados con las herramientas de computación en la nube UDx.

-Servir como PYME técnica para las actividades de evaluación de riesgos de seguridad.

Requisitos:

-Al menos 6 años de experiencia práctica con cuentas de AWS y configuraciones S3 para aplicaciones empresariales de computación... en la nube

-Al menos 3 años de experiencia con la gestión de configuraciones de AWS relacionadas con la privacidad y la seguridad de los datos médicos, especialmente el cumplimiento de HIPAA y 21 CFR Parte 820

-Se requiere experiencia anterior con entornos computacionales utilizados para bioinformática y herramientas NGS.

-Se requiere experiencia previa participando en evaluaciones de riesgos de seguridad y administración de servicios relacionados con AWS.

-Experiencia previa con funciones de respaldo y recuperación ante desastres.

-Experiencia previa seleccionando y administrando herramientas de monitoreo y auditoría de amenazas para servicios en la nube.

-Experiencia previa. colaborar con desarrolladores de software, biólogos computacionales, bioinformáticos, miembros del equipo de I+D y/o miembros del equipo de preguntas y respuestas.

-Se prefiere experiencia previa con controles de diseño para productos regulados. Se requiere una licenciatura en informática o ingeniería.

-Inglés ALTO

jobs_results.title: Senior Devops Openstack Neutron
jobs_results.description:
Missions

Attached to the Public Cloud Product Unit, you meet the following challenges :
• Contribute to the design and development of OVH Public Cloud product with a main focus on networking stack and services
• Become a major upstream player of our Open Source based Cloud stack - number 1 being Openstack and more specifically Neutron community
• Design and develop software architectures with variable geometry that can self-size based to meet business and functional specifications
• Design and implement test sets according to functional and technical specifications (benchmark, performance...)
• Ensure the correction of existing application and ensure continuous improvement of the quality of developments

At OVHcloud, we encourage boldness and initiative. Beyond these missions, we therefore expect you to be proactive and participate in the continuous improvement of your scope.

Profile
• You have experience on OpenStack with expertise in network management and control - Neutron... OpenVSwitch (or equivalent);
• Expertise in OpenStack Administration and troubleshooting (VLAN, OVS, BGP);
• You are proficient in a development language (Python, Go);
• You have a track of record in contributing to one or several Open Source communities
• You use one or more automated deployment and configuration management tools (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, etc.).
• You have good skills in CI / CD practices;
• Fluent English

jobs_results.title: Devops/Site Reliability Engineer For Tribes Studio - [WSJ027]
jobs_results.description:
About the job**:**Clovr Labs** is recruiting a **DevOps/Site Reliability Engineer **to work on new and interesting projects. Let's give you some context on who we're looking for and what to expect when you join the team. **Who we are**We are a boutique consulting firm specialized in the fields of cyber security and lean product development. We strive for simple, elegant solutions to difficult problems and have a passion for making things unfold one iteration at a time. **Our mission**We've been researching the Bitcoin blockchain, the Lightning Network and the world of Web3 as a platform for democratising all things digital. We would like to build our own space in the Web3 ecosystem,

with a particular focus to Lightning Network. **Your mission in the team**As a DevOps you will be incorporated in a new business unit dedicated to the Tribes Studio. We're looking for people who are curious, willing to embrace their goals and passionate about engineering. You will be part of a motivated... team, involved in the design, development and configuration of a new game. **What do we expect from you? **- You're willing to grow in an environment of ever-changing requirements, change priorities on the fly and never get attached to written code, code is ephemeral, it's the results that matter. - We generally prefer a solid understanding of the basics and the ability to learn and adapt rather than specialisation focused on one tool or set of tools. - There will be some direct interaction with customers, so the ability to understand their requirements and expectations is essential. **Key roles**- Experience with publishing apps in Apple Store and Play Store. - Assist in the development and implementation of a DevOps transformation. - Provide logical reasoning to address the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions. **It's nice to have**- Experience with automated build pipeline, continuous integration and continuous deployment, Gitlab experience is a plus. - Some hands-on experience designing, provisioning and maintaining a virtualized environment. - Knowledge of AWS architect and Docker. - Ability to provide timely solutions to problems in a well thought out and strategic manner. - Solid understanding of IT principles such as TCP/IP, Unix architecture, algorithms and logic. **What we offer**- Fully remote work within Spain, independence, ownership and flexibility is what you can expect from our mindset. - Fair wages for people with attitude above all [60k - 70k negotiable]. - Evolve in a stimulating and challenging environment. - Share and learn with a passionate and diverse team. - Work from home budget, choose what you need to create your dream home office. - Annual learning budget, learn a new programming language or go to a tech conference, if it is important for your career, it is important for us

You will be part of a motivated... team, involved in the design, development and configuration of a new game. **What do we expect from you? **- You're willing to grow in an environment of ever-changing requirements, change priorities on the fly and never get attached to written code, code is ephemeral, it's the results that matter. - We generally prefer a solid understanding of the basics and the ability to learn and adapt rather than specialisation focused on one tool or set of tools. - There will be some direct interaction with customers, so the ability to understand their requirements and expectations is essential. **Key roles**- Experience with publishing apps in Apple Store and Play Store. - Assist in the development and implementation of a DevOps transformation. - Provide logical reasoning to address the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions. **It's nice to have**- Experience with automated build pipeline, continuous integration and continuous deployment, Gitlab experience is a plus. - Some hands-on experience designing, provisioning and maintaining a virtualized environment. - Knowledge of AWS architect and Docker. - Ability to provide timely solutions to problems in a well thought out and strategic manner. - Solid understanding of IT principles such as TCP/IP, Unix architecture, algorithms and logic. **What we offer**- Fully remote work within Spain, independence, ownership and flexibility is what you can expect from our mindset. - Fair wages for people with attitude above all [60k - 70k negotiable]. - Evolve in a stimulating and challenging environment. - Share and learn with a passionate and diverse team. - Work from home budget, choose what you need to create your dream home office. - Annual learning budget, learn a new programming language or go to a tech conference, if it is important for your career, it is important for us

jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (m/f/d) - Spain - Spain
jobs_results.description:
Permanent employee,Full or part-time· Spain
Your mission

Come join our growing team!
apinity is an out-of-the-box SaaS solution to bring your API business strategy to the next level. Our integrated API marketplace enables you access to a wide range of API services with a strong insurance industry focus. As a team, we stand for scalability, agility, and innovation. We embrace cultural diversity with an adaptive mindset. Our core driver is integrating business processes and customer engagement into API management.

We are looking for a proactive, automaton-driven Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team in Spain who will bring experience and expertise to improve our software and infrastructure with 5 years of experience under his belt.
As Senior Engineer we are expecting self-drive, accountable Engineer who can lead features team within our solution.

apinity TechOps team is built up by team members' share and trust. We are looking for a candidate who can contribute to our values.
Our... tech stack

You will work directly with Terraform, Kubernetes, Istio, Kafka, Keycloak, Kong, Spring Boot, and Azure Cloud technologies as part of our tech stack.
Your Role and Responsibilities

In the role of Senior DevOps specialist, you will work within the TechOps team to define and implement the best security solutions and practices in all aspects of Information Security and ensure the engineering teams adhere to these. This hands-on position provides tools and technical planning to help teams focus on building highly secure software quickly.
• Analyze current technology utilized within the company and develop steps and processes to improve and expand upon them
• Build and implement solutions across the product life-cycle, such as CI/CD pipeline integrations, standalone security tooling, and process or workflow automation
• Continuously innovate and keep abreast of the latest IaaC practices, methods, and approaches and help ensure the Apinity product remains technically at the forefront of its field
• You produce Technical Documentation and Architecture Diagrams for automation pipelines and integrations.
• Mentor and train other engineers throughout the company and seek to improve processes companywide continually
• Take ownership of issues and act with a high sense of urgency when required
• Participate in on-call rotation, to support infrastructure and application incidents

Your profile
Required Technical and Professional Expertise

Familiarity with source control systems like Git and Github

Automation-first approach to application and infrastructure deployment, setup, and configuration with regard to required security controls

Experience with at least one cloud provider (Azure, Google, AWS)

Experience with Building Pipelines

Experience with infrastructure-as-code using Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, and Ansible

Experience in Containerization and Orchestration.

Experience with API gateways and service meshes

Strong communication, collaboration, and presentation skills

Openness to new topics and challenges

5 years of DevOps experience
Preferred Technical And Professional Expertise

Ability to thrive working with a team of people from different backgrounds in a highly collaborative, time-sensitive environment

Strong problem-solving (and problem-avoiding) skills and attention to detail (Application behavior, Networking, Security)

Experience with Azure services and technologies

Good communication skills and a team-oriented approach
Why us?

What You Can Look Forward To
• An exciting opportunity in an innovative and growing company with open communication
• Flat hierarchies and the freedom to work independently
• Quarterly team- and company events
• Homeoffice (within Spain and up to 100%), plus the option to work abroad for a limited number of days
• Flexible working hours, reimbursement for overtime and a competitive salary
• Open feedback culture and the opportunity to introduce your ideas
• Personal training budget and participation in relevant industry events, plus conferences
• Various opportunities to develop yourself professionally and personally in specialist and management functions

You want to become part of the team? We look forward to hearing from you!

Our integrated API marketplace enables you access to a wide range of API services with a strong insurance industry focus. Our core driver is integrating business processes and customer engagement into API management.
As a team, we stand for scalability, agility, and innovation. We embrace cultural diversity with an adaptive mindset.
#J-18808-Ljbffr
